notes.title: MAJOR UPDATE
notes.content:
[b]We are thrilled to announce a major update to the game![/b]
Total rework of scientist outpost.
New questline, enemy, and NPC.
Numerous systems have been revamped.
A lot of bugs have been fixed.
Added various in-game flavor elements.

[u][b]
Patch Notes for the Latest Build:[/b][/u]

[b]Sanity Changes:[/b]

Being in the dark now has a chance to decrease your sanity.
Removed reverse look controls.
Reduced sanity damage from enemies.

[b]Weapon Changes:[/b]

You can now reload weapons using bullet boxes instead of magazines.
New weapons added: Uzi, Sten, MG42, and laser artifact.
Updated item spawn mechanics.

[b]Poolrooms Outpost:[/b]

Henry can duplicate owned cards.
Updated Trader.
Added additional NPCs and player rooms/hideouts.
The game now starts in the poolrooms.

[b]Level Fun:[/b]

Multiple partygoers added..
Advancing the quest with Jenny/Alice now possible by dropping a plushie obtained from partygoers by making a cake.

[b]Asylumrooms:[/b]

Collider and door fixes.
Added card spawn and asylumrooms questline along with new scientist - Jeremy.
Introduced asylum enemies.

[b]Boss Changes:[/b]

Different cards from various biomes required to confront the boss.
Boss enters a second stage once below 50% HP.

[b]Quests Changes:[/b]

New asylumroom questline.
Completion of the kinderrooms questline.

[b]Other Changes:[/b]

Henry can craft another card of the same type if shown a card and you possess 10 cigarettes.
Added achievements.
Implemented a new realistic lighting system with baked realtime global illumination and flashlight support for navigating darkroom zones.
Various UI adjustments.
Fixed camera glitches.
Improved hit effects.
Optimized weapon muzzle flash.
Fixed item spawn issues in multiplayer.
Corrected weapon positions.
Increased single item spawns in zones.
Added posters explaining entities in the game world.
Skills are retained after death.

notes.title: Christmas Event & Update!
notes.content:
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43556496/dcdc3e97f4c070248f1cb1f1310c8bc1cdffef1f.png[/img]

[b]Christmas Special[/b]
1. Collect items from Christmas Gifts.
2. Use the Candy Pipe to destroy walls and enemies.
3. Enjoy cool Santa hats.

[b]What did we fix?[/b]

1.Totally reworked enemy AI.
2.The map is now static and optimized.
3. New shop with currency.
4. Autostacking everywhere.
5. Still WIP -reworking partier AI and cable monster AI.
6. Still WIP - new lighting.

[b]
[b]We're also planning a huge update in January, so stay tuned and do (not) noclip into the backrooms until then[/b][/b]

notes.title: Introducing Kinderrooms
notes.content:
🚀 Exciting Update Alert! New Features, Fixes, and More in the Latest Backrooms Cycle Release! 🚀

🎉 Introducing Kinderrooms: Dive into a world of wonder with the all-new Biome! Encounter Partygoer Larva Balloons floating merrily around, and join the charismatic Partygoer himself as he celebrates with his delectable cake.

🔧 Fixes and Enhancements:

Resolved the pesky spawn issues in Poolrooms for the third player

fixed Poolrooms locker loosing some items.

Dived into the details with various minor fixes, ensuring a smoother gameplay experience.

But that's not all! Kinderooms or fixing is far from over. I'm working on further improvements that will add depth and variety.

We want to extend our heartfelt gratitude to all of you who have supported us thus far. Your enthusiasm have been our driving force, propelling us forward. We're honored to have you by our side as we continue to shape Backrooms Cycle into the best backrooms game.

Thank you for being part of our incredible adventure, and remember – your feedback, bug reports, and suggestions fuel our progress. Join us in making Backrooms Cycle the best it can be!

Stay tuned for more updates and get ready to dive deeper into the mysteries of the Backrooms!

The Backrooms Cycle Development Team
